items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I remember when Spo-De-O-Dee came there from St. Louis

ctx.x: No, you couldn't quit. Because, I remember when Spo-De-O-Dee came there from St. Louis and these cats got on the train and came there and went into the Mike DeLisa's and beat the hell out of Spo-De-O-De.
and took him back to St. Louis where he was working in the Plantation there and says, "You quit when we tell you you can quit. You don't leave us."
